messages:
maria: Quick FYI — after we flipped the quantized build (reranker-rb4-q4_1) into staging I see a measurable NDCG hit on the golden holdout. Can someone triage?
aj: Numbers? which holdout + snapshot?
maria: holdout = golden-20k, snapshot = s3://redwood-evals/rerank/golden-20k/v2.jsonl. Summary from the offline run: 
```
model: reranker-rb4 -> reranker-rb4-q4_1
ndcg@10: 0.832 -> 0.798  (-3.3%)
mrr@10: 0.456 -> 0.452   (-0.9%)
short_queries (len<=8) ndcg@10: 0.765 -> 0.726 (-5.2%)
long_queries (len>80) ndcg@10: 0.849 -> 0.847 (-0.2%)
```
maria: full eval + per-slice CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/maria/rerank/1716684200/metrics.csv
tyler: Hmm short queries are the worst hit. Any preprocessing changes in the deploy?
sam: We did push a small preproc optimization in the preprocessing service last week: trim_whitespace=True by default now (was False). It was intended to reduce token counts for batching.
aj: Could that change priming/anchors? short queries often rely on leading whitespace for priming markers we use in the prompt templates.
maria: that was my suspicion — some of our priming uses leading '\n' or trailing ' ' to separate query from context. If those get stripped, the input tokens change.
aj: Can we reproduce with a toggled flag locally?
maria: Yes. Repro command I ran: 
```bash
./eval_rerank \\
  --model reranker-rb4-q4_1 \\
  --holdout s3://redwood-evals/relevance/golden-20k.jsonl \\
  --preproc.trim_ws=true \\
  --out /tmp/q4_trim_true.jsonl

./eval_rerank \\
  --model reranker-rb4-q4_1 \\
  --holdout s3://redwood-evals/relevance/golden-20k.jsonl \\
  --preproc.trim_ws=false \\
  --out /tmp/q4_trim_false.jsonl
```
aj: Great — can you diff the inputs to see how many queries changed tokenization boundaries?
maria: quick diff: ~3.8k queries out of 20k lost a leading whitespace or trailing marker; many fall into short_queries slice. I ran a quick tokenizer parity check: token counts changed for those ~3.8k.
tyler: That matches hit on short queries. If leading whitespace removal collapses our implicit separator, the reranker sees concatenated prompt+query and ranking changes.
sam: Reverting the default to False in staging now and will redeploy the preproc service — pushing rollback PR: https://github.com/redwood/preproc/pull/432 (cc @maria)
ci-bot: deploy-bot: rollback preproc v1.9.3 -> v1.9.2 triggered by sam, staging rollout started (10% -> 100%) :rocket:
maria: Thanks. After rollback can someone run the same offline eval (trim_ws=false) and post the metrics? I want to confirm delta goes away.
aj: I'll run a quick smoke run and post numbers in this thread in ~20m.
tyler: Also we should add a unit test to eval harness to assert priming separators preserved for short queries. I'll open a ticket.
sam: action: revert default + add note in changelog about priming-sensitive formats. Will follow up with a patch to make preproc option explicit in model-onboard docs.
maria: small follow-ups: 1) Maria will re-run slice diffs and attach per-template examples 2) Aj to run smoke eval in staging 3) Tyler to open test ticket 4) Sam to finish PR merge.
aj: smoke results (staging after rollback): 
```
ndcg@10: 0.832 -> 0.831  (-0.1%)
mrr@10: 0.456 -> 0.456  (0.0%)
short_queries ndcg@10: 0.765 -> 0.763 (-0.2%)
```
aj: Looks like rollback removed the majority of the regression.
maria: Perfect — closing triage. We'll add a preproc note in the bringup checklist: ensure trim_ws flag is explicit for any reranker onboarding. :white_check_mark:
tyler: +1, adding the checklist entry now.
sam: PR merged and staged prod-safe. :thumbsup:
